hook: My push cart has a mind of its own on every slope.
beats: Mulligan: I'll just park it right here.
setting: On the fairway on a gentle slope, fairway and green rolling out behind.
action: Mulligan lets go of a push cart that rolls away downhill on its own; he crawls after it as it tips over softly into the grass and his hat drops over his eyes.

dialogue.speaker: Mulligan
dialogue.line: I'll just park it right here.

sound: birdsong, wheels rattling, a soft tip-over, a frustrated squeal
judge: Runaway cart with 'Cardio' is a light but real button.
